newsitem.title: USA: U.S. imports of Russian palladium fall in December.
newsitem.headline: U.S. imports of Russian palladium fall in December.

text.p: U.S. imports of unwrought and powdered palladium from Russia fell to 10,907,279 grams in December from 23,456,673 grams in November, the Commerce Department said. In January to December, U.S. imports from Russia totalled 69,299,714 grams, the department said.

Total U.S. imports of unwrought and powdered palladium from all origins were 16,313,049 grams in December, compared with 31,922,542 grams in November. In January to December, imports from all origins totalled 124,934,965 grams.

U.S. imports of semimanufactured palladium from Russia rose to 397,028 grams in December from 143,273 grams in November. In January to December, U.S. imports of semimanufactured palladium from Russia totalled 13,753,074 grams.

U.S. imports of semimanufactured palladium from all origins were 1,579,263 grams in December, compared with 1,028,339 grams in November. In January to December, imports from all origins totalled 20,970,225 grams.
